settings.text:
Every order ships free within the United States — fully insured, tracked, and signature-required. In-stock pieces leave our workshop within 2–3 business days. Bespoke commissions and specially sourced stones (diamonds not listed on our site) are quoted with their own timeline before you commit.

International shipping is available on request; duties and taxes are the recipient's responsibility.
Choose your diamond and setting. We set it here in New York and deliver it within three business days.

Unworn jewelry, and unset diamonds with their certificate, may be returned or exchanged within 14 days of delivery, with a prepaid, insured label. Once your diamond is set, the ring can be exchanged but not returned. Engraved pieces, bespoke commissions, and specially sourced stones (diamonds not listed on our site) are final sale, and we are happy to offer an exchange or store credit.

Watches and timepieces may be exchanged only — they are not eligible for refunds. The exchange window is 7 days from delivery. The piece must be unworn, with all original papers, box, links, and tags. Contact us before shipping anything back so we can send a prepaid, insured label.
Every piece, including loose diamonds, carries a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, with complimentary annual cleaning and inspection. Resizing is included once on most rings.
